review: Each change needs a new entry at the top of CHANGELOG.md, and its heading uses the merge placeholder, not a fixed date: `## [Fix] - {PR_MERGE_DATE}`.
rule: Each change adds a CHANGELOG.md entry at the top whose heading ends with {PR_MERGE_DATE}, not a date.
check: CHANGELOG.md gains a heading `## [...] - {PR_MERGE_DATE}` and no heading with a fixed date
standing: When a Raycast extension changes: add a CHANGELOG.md entry at the top whose heading ends with {PR_MERGE_DATE}, not a date, because the Store bot fills in the date at merge.

review: Use `showFailureToast` from `@raycast/utils` for errors instead of building a failure toast by hand with `showToast({ style: Toast.Style.Failure })`.
rule: Errors are shown with showFailureToast from @raycast/utils, never with showToast and Toast.Style.Failure.
standing: When a Raycast extension shows an error: use showFailureToast from @raycast/utils, never showToast with Toast.Style.Failure, because it builds the error toast for you.

review: Remove the leftover debug `console.log` calls before it goes to the Store.
rule: No console.log is left in the extension's source.
check: no added line under src/ calls console.log
standing: When a Raycast extension's source changes: leave no console.log in it, because the Store review asks to remove debug output.

review: Load data with `useFetch`, `usePromise` or `useCachedPromise` from `@raycast/utils` instead of `useEffect` with `useState`; they handle loading, errors and caching for you.
rule: Data is loaded with useFetch, usePromise or useCachedPromise from @raycast/utils, not with useEffect and useState.
check: no added useEffect body awaits, fetches or calls .then
standing: When a Raycast extension loads data: use useFetch, usePromise or useCachedPromise from @raycast/utils, not useEffect with useState, because they handle loading, errors and caching.

review: Keep test material out of the extension: remove the test files and the `test` script; the Store build does not run them.
rule: The extension ships no test files and no test script.
check: no test file or tests folder is added, and package.json gains no test script
standing: When a Raycast extension changes: add no test files and no test script, because the Store build does not run them.
